name: 2S 18650 Li-ion pack with built-in BMS (7.4 V)
description: Two 18650 cells in series with a protection board: 7.4 V nominal, 8.4 V full, typically 2.5-3.5 Ah and 3-5 A.
notes: Continuous current is limited by the BMS (commonly 3 A, sometimes 5-10 A): check the BMS rating and cell rating. Servo stall currents can trip the BMS and reset the whole build.
Capacity depends on the cells (genuine 18650: 2.5-3.5 Ah; "9900 mAh" cells are fake).
Every part on the pack must accept 8.4 V. Charge with a 2S charger (8.4 V CC/CV), not a 5 V USB charger.
The BMS protects against over-discharge and short circuit, but a fuse is still good practice.

pins.name: BAT+
pins.label: P+
pins.note: Pack output after the BMS. Full 8.4 V; the BMS cuts off at about 2.5-3.0 V per cell (5.0-6.0 V).

geometry.note: Two 18650 cells (18 x 65 mm each) side by side plus wrap.
